scene.name: Ember Rift · Volcanic Pass
scene.dm_notes: Prepared from supplied image(1).png. Scale: 5 feet per printed square; 17.8125 source pixels per square, 32 × 32 board. Original 570 × 570 artwork is embedded unchanged. Lava blocks ordinary walking and emits light visually; damage is DM-adjudicated. Basalt ridges, pinnacles and slag boulders match cliff regions and block routes/attack lines. An added basalt causeway at M27–N29 supplies the southern lava crossing: this is a new 3D feature. Spawn is on the southern approach. New assets are installed into Imported · Ember Rift. No enemies or hidden encounter triggers have been invented.
